HyperFrames Studio vs FliEdit — UI/UX

Same d01 edit open in both editors, 4 Nov 2026 (M4, hyperframes@0.9.9). Left is HyperFrames, right is FliEdit. Research only — no FliEdit code changed.

Verdict: FliEdit's editing model is ahead; HyperFrames' chrome is calmer and shows more (thumbnails, waveforms, typed inspector). Top transfers: U1 light quiet chrome, U2 thumbnails + waveforms, U3 inspector header + empty state, U4 compact transport, U5 icon toggles. All rebuilt clean-room in the AppyDave light brand.
